column1: # English typo-correction set: context<TAB>typed<TAB>intended (context = text before the word, may be empty).
# Top-1: the middle slot (what space commits) is the intended word; top-3: it is anywhere in the bar.
# Rows whose intended word is the typed word are real words that must stay (its, lets, were, well).
# Hand-written for this repo: user reports from the phone (whats, apos, apostrap, preferenc,
# definately, prefarance), common contractions typed without the apostrophe, and common
# misspellings and keyboard slips. Intended words were checked against the bundled en.fst. No external data.
